title: Password and device rules
intro: This North & Co. internal guide applies to the fictional Canadian retail chain of 40 stores. The current edition took effect on March 1, 2026. The responsible team reviews it each September. Use the approved workflow below and ask the duty manager when the documented steps do not cover a situation.

sections.title: Access
sections.body: Every colleague uses an individual account protected by multi-factor authentication. Shared passwords are prohibited, including temporary access for a shift buddy. IT provisions role-based access after the manager submits an approved request. Never paste credentials into a support ticket.

facts.text: Use individual accounts with multi-factor authentication.

sections.title: Devices
sections.body: Lock screens whenever unattended and keep devices on the managed update schedule. Personal USB drives must not be attached to company equipment. Report a missing laptop, phone, or suspicious sign-in to the IT Service Desk immediately so access can be disabled.

facts.text: Report lost devices immediately to the IT Service Desk.
